text:
maya: quick sync — planning a gradual rollout for structured output / function-calling. proposing a compat flag + client-side opt-in. thoughts?

sam: +1. can we be explicit about flag names and audiences? also who owns the SDK bump?

maya: proposed flags:
- `ff_structured_output` (global server-side gate)
- `compat_fncall_v2` (compatibility mode for older clients)
- `sdk_behavior_map` (maps client versions -> behavior)

proposed rollout plan:
1) 1% global traffic (all models) for 48h; only server-side gate enabled. internal telemetry + schema checks.
2) 10% split across canary audiences: `internal-alpha`, `beta-partners`, `mobile-vnext` for 72h.
3) 100% with client opt-in after SDK bump and documentation.

guardrails: fallback to plain text if schema validation fails, rate-limit structured responses to avoid cascading errors, automatic rollback on schema-error rate > 0.5% (configurable).

igor: runtime notes — we need a request header to mark compat: `X-Compat-Version: fncall-v2` so we can route without guessing. KV cache keys should include the compat tag or we'll get mixed cache entries. batching layer needs to respect the flag per-request.

jen: for audiences, prefer staged cohorts: `eng-internal`, `platform-early`, `customers-beta-1`. we should avoid exposing to non-beta partners until schema warnings are gone.

sam: SDK owners: tagging @tess for the JS/TS SDK bump and @jen for mobile. Tess — is there a safe client toggle we can expose that toggles only producer/consumer behavior, not the transport?

tess: I can do the JS/TS bump. plan: add `structuredOutput: { enabled: boolean, compat: "fncall-v2" }` to config. will add runtime guard so older SDKs ignore the field. PR shortly: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/456 (WIP).

luis: telemetry/observability asks — we should emit these metrics:
- `structured_output.requests.total`
- `structured_output.schema_errors.count`
- `structured_output.fallbacks.count`
- `structured_output.latency.p50/p95`
- `compat_mismatch.count`

also want a regression alert: when schema_errors.rate increases by > 3x baseline in 30m, auto rollback job triggers a rollout reversal. is that OK?

maya: yes. add a dashboard tile and an alert runbook. Owners: eng-sre for alerts, eng-runtime for rollback implementation.

tess: ping — I added a feature-flag key to the SDK PR and a client-side opt-in test. still need someone from runtime to review the header handling.

igor: I'll review the header handling — quick note: we should stamp traces with `compat=v2` so we can slice traces later. also please add a short-circuit in batching when flag disabled (cheap check).

deploy-bot: feature flag `ff_structured_output` created in LaunchDarkly (key: ff_structured_output). Creator: maya. Environment: staging.

sam: code review ping @igor @tess — please take a look at the PRs (runtime + SDK). want to merge staging guardrails by EOD tomorrow.

tess: review done (minor nits). CI failing on one flaky test, rerunning.

luis: will set up dashboard and alert after PRs merge. need names for the metrics prefixes — using `structured_output.*` is fine.

maya: schedule: toggle on in staging now, schedule 1% roll for 2026-04-01T15:00Z, monitor 48h, then expand to audiences 2026-04-03. if any schema_error_rate > 0.5% rollback immediately.

sam: noted. I'll update the rollout doc and add the canary audience lists.

jen: I'll coordinate sending a short note to partners in `beta-partners` once we hit 10%.

maya: thanks everyone — will post a short follow-up with links: PRs, feature flag, dashboard. :thumbsup:
